Status

This summary is based on the discussion with Patrick on 13 October 2026. It is tentative. The final scope and project plan will be agreed together with all key Elite Fit stakeholders.

Objective

Grow Elite Fit: more members and more day-pass sales.

Two levers increase visibility and website traffic.

  1. 1

    Optimisation for Google and AI search (SEO).

    Elite Fit is found for the searches its guests make. Visibility drives traffic to the website.

  2. 2

    A premium website, optimised for conversion.

    The website reflects the brand and converts visitors: a day pass or a membership in a few taps.

More visibility

Elite Fit is found on Google and in AI search.

2

More traffic

More people reach your website and the day-pass page.

More sales

More day passes and memberships sold.

Services and deliverables

Five services, each with defined deliverables.

  1. 1

    Website design and development

    • Redesigned website in WordPress, built from Elite Fit's brand guide and design
    • 8 to 12 core pages: home, services, about, trainers
    • Mobile first, day pass on the first screen
    • Online shop: a day pass or a membership in three taps
  2. 2

    SEO: optimisation for Google and AI search

    • Search research and a prioritised list of searches
    • 50+ SEO pages, submitted in waves; the final number depends on the research
    • Location pages and one page for the equipment brands
    • One blog post a week, Google and Bing business profiles, monthly tracking and optimisation
  3. 3

    Technical integration

    • GymMaster, Moka and the café system connected to website, shop and CRM
    • Payments integrated: card, local bank and QRIS
    • Every step tested end to end as a guest
    • One seamless back end, or one platform connected instead if Elite Fit moves to one
  4. 4

    CRM set-up

    • One inbox for every guest message
    • Automatic welcome messages by WhatsApp, or by SMS from an Australian number
    • Guest data structured: tags, pipeline and segments
    • Day-pass follow-up that invites guests to become members
  5. 5

    Target marketing and business strategy

    • Target groups, and offers per target group
    • Platform strategy
    • Baseline numbers and targets
    • Strategy sessions with Raoul and a quality review of every deliverable

Google and AI search

Strategy

One page per search worth winning, open niches first.

Tools

50+ pages, built and submitted in waves after the relaunch; the final number depends on the research. One blog post a week. Location pages for Pererenan, Canggu, Seseh, Tumbak Bayuh and Dalung; one page for the equipment brands. Google and Bing business profiles.

Routine

Elite Fit reviews the search list. Digital Movement tracks and optimises monthly.

Website

Strategy

Brand first. Day pass on the first screen.

Tools

WordPress, built from your design, mobile first. 8 to 12 core pages: home, services, about, trainers.

Routine

Elite Fit approves each page. One club contact approves changes to prices, timetable and offers.

Online shop

Strategy

No barrier: a day pass or a membership in three taps.

Tools

Payment by card, local bank or QRIS.

Routine

Elite Fit approves the shop before launch.

CRM: WhatsApp and SMS

Strategy

Convert day-pass guests into members.

One inbox for every guest message. Automatic welcome messages by WhatsApp, or by SMS from an Australian number.

Your systems, connected
